```javascript
const User = require('../models/User');
const bcrypt = require('bcrypt');
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'your-jwt-secret';

const register = async (req, res) => {
  const { name, email, password, role } = req.body;
  const hashed = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
  const user = await User.create({ name, email, password: hashed, role });
  const token = jwt.sign({ id: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role }, JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '1d' });
  res.status(201).json({ user: { id: user.id, name: user.name, email: user.email, role: user.role }, token });
};

const login = async (req, res) => {
  const { email, password } = req.body;
  const user = await User.findByEmail(email);
  if (!user) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'User not found' });
  const match = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password);
  if (!match) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid password' });
  const token = jwt.sign({ id: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role }, JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '1d' });
  res.json({ user: { id: user.id, name: user.name, email: user.email, role: user.role }, token });
};

const verifyToken = (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.header('Authorization')?.replace('Bearer ', '');
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET);
    req.user = decoded;
    next();
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid token' });
  }
};

module.exports = { register, login, verifyToken };
```

```javascript
const Contract = require('../models/Contract');
const Signature = require('../models/Signature');
const crypto = require('../utils/crypto');
const { addSignatureToPdf } = require('../utils/pdf');

const sign = async (req, res) => {
  const { contractId, name, signature } = req.body;
  const userId = req.user.id;

  const contract = await Contract.findById(contractId);
  if (!contract) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contract not found' });
  if (contract.userId !== userId && contract.signedBy.includes(userId)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Already signed' });
  }

  const encryptedSignature = crypto.encrypt(signature);
  const signatureData = { contractId, userId, name, signature: encryptedSignature };

  await Signature.create(signatureData);

  const contractWithSignature = await Contract.findById(contractId);
  if (!contractWithSignature) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contract not found' });

  const currentSigners = contractWithSignature.signedBy || [];
  if (currentSigners.includes(userId)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Already signed' });
  }

  await Contract.updateStatus(contractId, 'pending');
  await Contract.create({
    title: contractWithSignature.title,
    description: contractWithSignature.description,
    category: contractWithSignature.category,
    tags: contractWithSignature.tags,
    userId: contractWithSignature.userId,
    templateId: contractWithSignature.templateId,
    status: 'pending',
    signedBy: [...currentSigners, userId],
  });

  // Generate PDF with signature
  const pdfPath = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'public', 'uploads', `${contractId}.pdf`);
  await addSignatureToPdf(pdfPath, signatureData);

  res.json({ message: 'Signed successfully', contractId });
};

const listSignatures = async (req, res) => {
  const signatures = await Signature.findByContract(req.params.id);
  res.json(signatures);
};

module.exports = { sign, listSignatures };
```

```javascript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export const useAuth = () => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (token) {
      try {
        const decoded = JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1]));
        setUser(decoded);
      } catch (e) {
        setUser(null);
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  return { user, loading };
};
```

answer: Building a **network security scanner** capable of detecting common web vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQLi, etc.) requires a combination of: - **HTTP client** (requests library) - **HTML/JS parsing** (BeautifulSoup, lxml, or regex) - **Vulnerability detection logic** - **Persistence** (SQLite for scan history) - **Scheduling** (APScheduler or threading.Timer) - **Output formatting** (rich, tabulate, or plain text) - **Command-line interface** (argparse) Below is a **complete, production-ready Python scanner** named **`webguard`**. It is modular, well-documented, and designed for educational and internal security testing purposes. --- ## ✅ Features - Detects: XSS, CSRF, SQLi, Open Redirect, Clickjacking, Insecure Headers - Severity levels: High, Medium, Low - Scan history persistence (SQLite) - Scheduled automatic scans - Command-line interface with flags - Colorized output --- ## 📦 Requirements ```bash pip install requests beautifulsoup4 lxml tabulate rich apscheduler python-dotenv ``` --- ## 📁 Project Structure ``` webguard/ ├── __init__.py ├── scanner.py # core scanner logic ├── db.py # SQLite persistence ├── scheduler.py # APScheduler integration ├── cli.py # CLI interface ├── config.py # defaults + dotenv └── requirements.txt ``` --- ## 📄 `config.py` ```python import os from dotenv import load_dotenv load_dotenv() # Default settings DEFAULT_BASE_URL = os.getenv("WEBGUARD_BASE_URL", "http://localhost") DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = int(os.getenv("WEBGUARD_TIMEOUT", 10)) DEFAULT_RETRIES = int(os.getenv("WEBGUARD_RETRIES", 3)) DEFAULT_DELAY = float(os.getenv("WEBGUARD_DELAY", 0.5)) DEFAULT_HEADERS = { "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36", "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8", "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.5", "Accept-Encoding": "gzip, deflate", "Connection": "keep-alive", } # Default payloads PAYLOADS = { "xss": [ "", "", "", ], } SEVERITY_MAP = { "high": "🔴 High", "medium": "🟠 Medium", "low": "🟢 Low", } # Allowed methods for testing ALLOWED_METHODS = ["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE"] ``` --- ## 📄 `db.py` ```python import sqlite3 import json from datetime import datetime from typing import List, Dict, Any class ScanDB: def __init__(self, db_path: str = "webguard.db"): self.db_path = db_path self.init_db() def init_db(self): with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scans ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT NOT NULL, base_url TEXT NOT NULL, method TEXT NOT NULL, status_code INTEGER NOT NULL, headers TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, duration REAL NOT NULL, vulnerabilities JSON NOT NULL ) """) cursor.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, scan_id INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, severity TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, remediation TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans(id) ) """) conn.commit() def save_scan(self, scan: Dict[str, Any]) -> int: with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(""" INSERT INTO scans (url, base_url, method, status_code, headers, body, created_at, duration, vulnerabilities) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) """, ( scan["url"], scan["base_url"], scan["method"], scan["status_code"], json.dumps(scan["headers"]), scan["body"], datetime.now().isoformat(), scan["duration"], json.dumps(scan["vulnerabilities"]), )) conn.commit() return cursor.lastrowid def get_latest_scan(self, limit: int = 5) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(""" SELECT id, url, base_url, method, status_code, created_at, duration FROM scans ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? """, (limit,)) rows = cursor.fetchall() return [ { "id": r[0], "url": r[1], "base_url": r[2], "method": r[3], "status_code": r[4], "created_at": r[5], "duration": r[6], } for r in rows ] def get_vulnerabilities(self, scan_id: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(""" SELECT title, severity, description, remediation FROM history WHERE scan_id = ? ORDER BY severity DESC """, (scan_id,)) rows = cursor.fetchall() return [ { "title": r[0], "severity": r[1], "description": r[2], "remediation": r[3], } for r in rows ] ``` --- ## 📄 `scanner.py` ```python import requests import time import re import json import html from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional, Any from bs4 import BeautifulSoup import logging from config import PAYLOADS, SEVERITY_MAP, DEFAULT_HEADERS, ALLOWED_METHODS logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) class WebGuardScanner: def __init__( self, base_url: str, headers: Dict[str, str] = DEFAULT_HEADERS, timeout: int = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, retries: int = DEFAULT_RETRIES, delay: float = DEFAULT_DELAY, ): self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/") self.headers = headers self.timeout = timeout self.retries = retries self.delay = delay self.session = requests.Session() self.session.headers.update(self.headers) self._csrf_token = None def _request(self, method: str, url: str, **kwargs) -> requests.Response: for attempt in range(self.retries): try: response = self.session.request(method, url, **kwargs) response.raise_for_status() time.sleep(self.delay) return response except Exception as e: logger.warning(f"Attempt {attempt + 1} failed: {e}") if attempt == self.retries - 1: raise time.sleep(1.5 ** attempt) def _extract_csrf_token(self, response: requests.Response) -> Optional[str]: """Extract CSRF token from response HTML.""" if response.status_code != 200 or not response.text: return None soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "lxml") token = None for name in PAYLOADS["csrf"]: for tag in soup.find_all(attrs={"name": name}): token = tag.get("value") break if token: break return token def _inject_payload(self, response: requests.Response, payload: str) -> str: """Inject payload into HTML body and return modified text.""" if not response.text: return response.text soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "lxml") body = soup.body if body: body.append(BeautifulSoup(payload, "lxml")) return str(soup) def _is_redirect(self, response: requests.Response) -> bool: """Check if response is a redirect.""" return response.status_code in [301, 302, 303, 307, 308] def _get_redirect_target(self, response: requests.Response) -> str: """Get final redirect URL.""" if not self._is_redirect(response): return "" parsed = urlparse(response.headers.get("Location", "")) if not parsed.netloc: return urljoin(self.base_url, parsed.path) return parsed.geturl() def _detect_clickjacking(self, response: requests.Response) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Detect clickjacking via X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy.""" issues = [] headers = dict(response.headers) xfo = headers.get("X-Frame-Options", "").lower() csp = headers.get("Content-Security-Policy", "").lower() if "frame" in xfo or "deny" in xfo: issues.append({ "title": "X-Frame-Options header allows framing", "severity": "low", "description": f"X-Frame-Options header is set to '{xfo}', which may allow clickjacking.", "remediation": "Set X-Frame-Options to 'DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN' to prevent clickjacking.", }) if "frame-ancestors" not in csp: issues.append({ "title": "Missing Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors", "severity": "low", "description": "Content-Security-Policy does not include 'frame-ancestors', leaving the site vulnerable to clickjacking.", "remediation": "Add 'frame-ancestors' directive to Content-Security-Policy header.", }) return issues def _detect_insecure_headers(self, response: requests.Response) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Detect insecure headers.""" issues = [] headers = dict(response.headers) insecure = [ ("X-Powered-By", "Server signature leaks internal framework version."), ("Server", "Server signature leaks internal framework version."), ("X-AspNet-Version", "Server signature leaks internal framework version."), ("X-AspNetMvc-Version", "Server signature leaks internal framework version."), ] for header, desc in insecure: if header in headers: issues.append({ "title": f"Insecure header: {header}", "severity": "low", "description": desc, "remediation": f"Remove the '{header}' header from server responses.", }) return issues def _detect_open_redirect(self, response: requests.Response) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Detect open redirect by checking redirect targets.""" issues = [] redirect_target = self._get_redirect_target(response) if redirect_target and not redirect_target.startswith(self.base_url): issues.append({ "title": "Open Redirect Detected", "severity": "high", "description": f"Application redirects to '{redirect_target}' without validating the target URL.", "remediation": "Validate and sanitize all redirect URLs; only allow redirects to whitelisted domains.", }) return issues def _detect_sql_injection(self, response: requests.Response) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Detect SQLi via error messages or unusual response patterns.""" issues = [] body = response.text.lower() sqli_indicators = [ "mysql", "sqlite", "postgres", "error", "exception", "syntax", "column", "table", "union", "select", "from", "where", "having", "order", "limit", "insert", "update", "delete", "drop", "truncate", "create", "alter", ] if any(ind in body for ind in sqli_indicators): issues.append({ "title": "SQL Injection Risk", "severity": "high", "description": f"Response contains SQL-related keywords: {', '.join([ind for ind in sqli_indicators if ind in body])}.", "remediation": "Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) and input validation.", }) return issues def _detect_xss(self, response: requests.Response, payload: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Detect XSS by checking if payload appears in response.""" issues = [] body = response.text if payload in body: issues.append({ "title": "Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Detected", "severity": "high", "description": f"Injected payload '{payload}' was found in the response body.", "remediation": "Sanitize all user input; use Content Security Policy (CSP) with 'script-src' directives.", }) return issues def _detect_csrf(self, response: requests.Response) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Detect CSRF by looking for tokens in forms.""" issues = [] soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "lxml") forms = soup.find_all("form") if forms: for form in forms: token = None for name in PAYLOADS["csrf"]: tag = form.find(attrs={"name": name}) if tag: token = tag.get("value") break if token: issues.append({ "title": "CSRF Token Detected", "severity": "medium", "description": f"Form contains CSRF token '{token}'.", "remediation": "Ensure double-submit cookie pattern or use SameSite cookies.", }) return issues def _scan_endpoint(self, method: str, url: str, payload: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]: """Scan a single endpoint.""" try: start = time.time() response = self._request(method, url, params=payload) duration = time.time() - start vulnerabilities = [] issues = [] # Clickjacking issues.extend(self._detect_clickjacking(response)) # Insecure headers issues.extend(self._detect_insecure_headers(response)) # Open redirect issues.extend(self._detect_open_redirect(response)) # SQLi issues.extend(self._detect_sql_injection(response)) # XSS issues.extend(self._detect_xss(response, payload)) # CSRF issues.extend(self._detect_csrf(response)) # Aggregate by severity severity_map = {"high": 0, "medium": 1, "low": 2} issues.sort(key=lambda x: severity_map[x["severity"]]) for issue in issues: vulnerabilities.append({ "title": issue["title"], "severity": issue["severity"], "description": issue["description"], "remediation": issue["remediation"], }) return { "url": url, "method": method, "status_code": response.status_code, "headers": dict(response.headers), "body": response.text, "duration": duration, "vulnerabilities": vulnerabilities, } except Exception as e: logger.error(f"Error scanning {url}: {e}") return { "url": url, "method": method, "status_code": 0, "headers": {}, "body": str(e), "duration": 0, "vulnerabilities": [], } def scan(self, urls: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: """Scan multiple URLs.""" results = [] for url in urls: for method in ALLOWED_METHODS: result = self._scan_endpoint(method, url) results.append(result) if result["vulnerabilities"]: logger.warning(f"⚠ Vulnerabilities found at {url} ({method}): {len(result['vulnerabilities'])}") return results def scan_with_payloads(self, urls: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: """Scan with XSS payloads.""" results = [] for url in urls: for method in ALLOWED_METHODS: for payload in PAYLOADS["xss"]: result = self._scan_endpoint(method, url, payload) results.append(result) if result["vulnerabilities"]: logger.warning(f"⚠ Vulnerabilities found at {url} ({method}): {len(result['vulnerabilities'])}") return results def get_csrf_token(self, url: str) -> Optional[str]: """Get CSRF token for a URL.""" try: response = self._request("GET", url) return self._extract_csrf_token(response) except Exception: return None ``` --- ## 📄 `scheduler.py` ```python from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler from apscheduler.triggers.cron import CronTrigger import logging from typing import List, Callable from config import DEFAULT_BASE_URL logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) class WebGuardScheduler: def __init__(self, scanner: WebGuardScanner, db: ScanDB): self.scanner = scanner self.db = db self.scheduler = BackgroundScheduler() self.jobs = {} def add_job(self, name: str, urls: List[str], interval: str, **kwargs) -> None: """Add a scheduled scan job.""" trigger = CronTrigger.from_crontab(interval) job = self.scheduler.add_job( self._run_scan_job, trigger=trigger, args=[urls], id=name, name=name, **kwargs ) self.jobs[name] = job logger.info(f"📅 Scheduled scan '{name}' with interval '{interval}'") def _run_scan_job(self, urls: List[str]) -> None: """Run a scheduled scan job.""" logger.info(f"🚀 Running scheduled scan on {len(urls)} URLs...") results = self.scanner.scan(urls) for result in results: if result["vulnerabilities"]: logger.warning(f"⚠ Vulnerabilities found: {len(result['vulnerabilities'])}") self.db.save_scan(result) logger.info("✅ Scheduled scan completed.") def start(self) -> None: """Start the scheduler.""" self.scheduler.start() logger.info("⏰ WebGuard scheduler started.") def stop(self) -> None: """Stop the scheduler.""" self.scheduler.shutdown() logger.info("⏹ WebGuard scheduler stopped.") def list_jobs(self) -> List[str]: """List all scheduled jobs.""" return [job.id for job in self.scheduler.get_jobs()] ``` --- ## 📄 `cli.py` ```python import argparse import sys import os from rich.console import Console from rich.table import ### 1. `core.py` — Main logic

```python
# backup_tool/core.py

import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
import shutil
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any

from storage import Storage
from cloud import Cloud
from ui import UI

class BackupTool:
    def __init__(self, config_path: str = "config.json"):
        self.config = self._load_config(config_path)
        self.storage = Storage(self.config)
        self.cloud = Cloud(self.config) if self.config.get("cloud_enabled", False) else None
        self.ui = UI()
        self._init_db()

    def _load_config(self, config_path: str) -> dict:
        with open(config_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)

    def _init_db(self):
        """Initialize SQLite databases for notes and tasks."""
        for db_name in ["notes", "tasks"]:
            db_path = self.storage.get_db_path(db_name)
            if not os.path.exists(db_path):
                conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute(f'''
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                        title TEXT NOT NULL,
                        content TEXT NOT NULL,
                        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    )
                ''')
                conn.commit()
                conn.close()

    def list_data_sources(self) -> List[str]:
        """List available data sources (notes, tasks)."""
        return ["notes", "tasks"]

    def get_entries(self, source: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Fetch all entries from a source."""
        db_path = self.storage.get_db_path(source)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM entries ORDER BY created_at DESC")
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        conn.close()
        return [
            {
                "id": row[0],
                "title": row[1],
                "content": row[2],
                "created_at": row[3],
                "updated_at": row[4]
            }
            for row in rows
        ]

    def add_entry(self, source: str, title: str, content: str) -> int:
        """Add a new entry and return its ID."""
        db_path = self.storage.get_db_path(source)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute(f'''
            INSERT INTO entries (title, content)
            VALUES (?, ?)
        ''', (title, content))
        conn.commit()
        entry_id = cursor.lastrowid
        conn.close()
        return entry_id

    def update_entry(self, source: str, entry_id: int, title: str, content: str) -> bool:
        """Update an existing entry."""
        db_path = self.storage.get_db_path(source)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute(f'''
            UPDATE entries
            SET title = ?, content = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE id = ?
        ''', (title, content, entry_id))
        success = cursor.rowcount > 0
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        return success

    def delete_entry(self, source: str, entry_id: int) -> bool:
        """Delete an entry."""
        db_path = self.storage.get_db_path(source)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute(f'''
            DELETE FROM entries WHERE id = ?
        ''', (entry_id,))
        success = cursor.rowcount > 0
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        return success

    def backup(self, source: str) -> str:
        """Backup a source to local and optionally cloud."""
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        backup_name = f"{source}_{timestamp}"
        backup_path = self.storage.get_backup_path(source, backup_name)

        # Create local backup
        db_path = self.storage.get_db_path(source)
        shutil.copy2(db_path, backup_path)

        # Add version record
        self._add_version(source, backup_path)

        # Cloud backup if enabled
        if self.cloud:
            cloud_path = f"{backup_name}.sqlite"
            self.cloud.upload(backup_path, cloud_path)

        return backup_path

    def _add_version(self, source: str, backup_path: str) -> None:
        """Record backup version."""
        version_path = self.storage.get_version_path(source)
        entry = {
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "backup_path": backup_path,
            "source": source
        }
        if not os.path.exists(version_path):
            with open(version_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump([entry], f)
        else:
            with open(version_path, "r+", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                versions = json.load(f)
                versions.append(entry)
                # Keep only max_versions
                if len(versions) > self.config.get("max_versions", 5):
                    versions = versions[-self.config.get("max_versions", 5):]
                f.seek(0)
                f.truncate()
                json.dump(versions, f)

    def list_versions(self, source: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """List all versions for a source."""
        version_path = self.storage.get_version_path(source)
        if not os.path.exists(version_path):
            return []
        with open(version_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)

    def restore_version(self, source: str, version_idx: int) -> str:
        """Restore a specific version."""
        versions = self.list_versions(source)
        if not versions:
            return "No versions found."
        version = versions[version_idx]
        backup_path = version["backup_path"]
        db_path = self.storage.get_db_path(source)
        # Restore
        shutil.copy2(backup_path, db_path)
        # Update versions list
        versions[version_idx]["restored_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
        with open(self.storage.get_version_path(source), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(versions, f)
        return f"Restored from version {version_idx}: {version['timestamp']}"

    def diff_versions(self, source: str, v1_idx: int, v2_idx: int) -> str:
        """Show diff between two versions."""
        v1 = self.list_versions(source)[v1_idx]
        v2 = self.list_versions(source)[v2_idx]
        v1_path = v1["backup_path"]
        v2_path = v2["backup_path"]
        if not os.path.exists(v1_path) or not os.path.exists(v2_path):
            return "One or both backups missing."
        with sqlite3.connect(v1_path) as c1, sqlite3.connect(v2_path) as c2:
            c1.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            c2.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            c1.execute("SELECT * FROM entries ORDER BY id")
            c2.execute("SELECT * FROM entries ORDER BY id")
            rows1 = c1.fetchall()
            rows2 = c2.fetchall()
            if len(rows1) != len(rows2):
                return f"Row count differs: {len(rows1)} vs {len(rows2)}"
            diff = []
            for r1, r2 in zip(rows1, rows2):
                if r1["content"] != r2["content"]:
                    diff.append(f"Entry {r1['id']}: {r1['title']} -> {r2['title']}")
            return "\n".join(diff) if diff else "No differences found."

    def run_scheduler(self) -> None:
        """Run scheduled backups."""
        if not self.config.get("auto_backup", True):
            return
        for source in self.list_data_sources():
            schedule_str = self.config["schedule"].get(source, None)
            if schedule_str:
                self.ui.info(f"Scheduled backup for {source}: {schedule_str}")
                # Simulate cron scheduling via `schedule` library
                try:
                    from schedule import every
                    import threading
                    import time as ttime
                    job = every().cron(schedule_str).do(self._run_scheduled_backup, source)
                    # Start in background
                    thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run_scheduler_loop, args=(job,))
                    thread.daemon = True
                    thread.start()
                except Exception as e:
                    self.ui.error(f"Failed to schedule {source}: {e}")

    def _run_scheduled_backup(self, source: str) -> None:
        """Callback for scheduled backup."""
        try:
            self.backup(source)
            self.ui.info(f"Backup completed for {source}")
        except Exception as e:
            self.ui.error(f"Backup failed for {source}: {e}")

    def _run_scheduler_loop(self, job) -> None:
        """Keep scheduler alive."""
        while True:
            job.run_pending()
            ttime.sleep(1)

    def menu(self) -> None:
        """Main menu loop."""
        self.ui.clear()
        while True:
            self.ui.print_banner()
            self.ui.print_menu()
            choice = self.ui.get_input("Choose an option: ").strip()
            if choice == "1":
                self._list_entries()
            elif choice == "2":
                self._add_entry_ui()
            elif choice == "3":
                self._update_entry_ui()
            elif choice == "4":
                self._delete_entry_ui()
            elif choice == "5":
                self._backup_ui()
            elif choice == "6":
                self._list_versions_ui()
            elif choice == "7":
                self._restore_ui()
            elif choice == "8":
                self._diff_ui()
            elif choice == "9":
                self._schedule_ui()
            elif choice == "0":
                self.ui.info("Goodbye!")
                break
            else:
                self.ui.error("Invalid choice. Try again.")

    def _list_entries(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        entries = self.get_entries(source)
        if not entries:
            self.ui.info("No entries found.")
            return
        self.ui.print_table(
            ["ID", "Title", "Content (first 30 chars)", "Created", "Updated"],
            [
                [
                    e["id"],
                    e["title"],
                    e["content"][:30] + "..." if len(e["content"]) > 30 else e["content"],
                    e["created_at"],
                    e["updated_at"]
                ]
                for e in entries
            ]
        )

    def _add_entry_ui(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        title = self.ui.get_input("Title: ").strip()
        content = self.ui.get_input("Content: ").strip()
        if not title:
            self.ui.error("Title is required.")
            return
        entry_id = self.add_entry(source, title, content)
        self.ui.info(f"Entry added with ID {entry_id}")

    def _update_entry_ui(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        entry_id = int(self.ui.get_input("Entry ID: ").strip())
        title = self.ui.get_input("New title (leave blank to keep): ").strip()
        content = self.ui.get_input("New content (leave blank to keep): ").strip()
        if not title and not content:
            self.ui.error("Nothing to update.")
            return
        if title:
            self.update_entry(source, entry_id, title, content)
        else:
            self.update_entry(source, entry_id, content, content)
        self.ui.info("Entry updated.")

    def _delete_entry_ui(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        entry_id = int(self.ui.get_input("Entry ID: ").strip())
        if self.delete_entry(source, entry_id):
            self.ui.info("Entry deleted.")
        else:
            self.ui.error("Entry not found.")

    def _backup_ui(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        self.backup(source)
        self.ui.info("Backup completed.")

    def _list_versions_ui(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        versions = self.list_versions(source)
        if not versions:
            self.ui.info("No versions found.")
            return
        self.ui.print_table(
            ["Idx", "Timestamp", "Backup Path", "Restored"],
            [
                [
                    i,
                    v["timestamp"],
                    v["backup_path"],
                    v.get("restored_at", "No")
                ]
                for i, v in enumerate(versions)
            ]
        )

    def _restore_ui(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        versions = self.list_versions(source)
        if not versions:
            self.ui.info("No versions found.")
            return
        self.ui.print_table(
            ["Idx", "Timestamp", "Backup Path"],
            [
                [i, v["timestamp"], v["backup_path"]]
                for i, v in enumerate(versions)
            ]
        )
        try:
            idx = int(self.ui.get_input("Enter version index to restore: ").strip())
            if idx < 0 or idx >= len(versions):
                self.ui.error("Invalid index.")
                return
            result = self.restore_version(source, idx)
            self.ui.info(result)
        except ValueError:
            self.ui.error("Invalid index.")

    def _diff_ui(self) -> None:
        source = self.ui.get_input("Which source? (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        versions = self.list_versions(source)
        if len(versions) < 2:
            self.ui.info("Need at least 2 versions to diff.")
            return
        self.ui.print_table(
            ["Idx", "Timestamp"],
            [
                [i, v["timestamp"]]
                for i, v in enumerate(versions)
            ]
        )
        try:
            idx1 = int(self.ui.get_input("First version index: ").strip())
            idx2 = int(self.ui.get_input("Second version index: ").strip())
            if idx1 == idx2:
                self.ui.error("Versions must differ.")
                return
            if idx1 < 0 or idx1 >= len(versions) or idx2 < 0 or idx2 >= len(versions):
                self.ui.error("Invalid indices.")
                return
            diff = self.diff_versions(source, idx1, idx2)
            self.ui.info("Differences:")
            print(diff)
        except ValueError:
            self.ui.error("Invalid indices.")

    def _schedule_ui(self) -> None:
        self.ui.info("Current schedule:")
        for source in self.list_data_sources():
            schedule_str = self.config["schedule"].get(source, "Not scheduled")
            self.ui.info(f"  {source}: {schedule_str}")
        new_source = self.ui.get_input("Enter source to schedule (notes/tasks): ").strip().lower()
        if new_source not in self.list_data_sources():
            self.ui.error("Unknown source.")
            return
        new_schedule = self.ui.get_input("Enter cron schedule (e.g., 0 3 * * *): ").strip()
        self.config["schedule"][new_source] = new_schedule
        self._save_config()
        self.ui.info(f"Schedule updated for {new_source}: {new_schedule}")

    def _save_config(self) -> None:
        with open("config.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self.config, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

def main():
    tool = BackupTool()
    tool.run_scheduler()
    tool.menu()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
# backup_tool/cloud.py

from googleapiclient.discovery import build
from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import InstalledAppFlow
from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

# If modifying these scopes, delete the file token.json.
SCOPES = ['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive']

class Cloud:
    def __init__(self, config: dict):
        self.config = config
        self.credentials_path = Path(config.get("google_credentials_path", "credentials.json"))
        self.token_path = Path("token.json")
        self.service = None
        self._authorize()

    def _authorize(self) -> None:
        """Authenticate with Google Drive API."""
        creds = None
        if self.token_path.exists():
            creds = Credentials.from_authorized_user_file(self.token_path, SCOPES)
        if not creds or not creds.valid:
            if creds and creds.expired and creds.refresh_token:
                creds.refresh(Request())
            else:
                flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_secrets_file(
                    self.credentials_path, SCOPES
                )
                creds = flow.run_local_server(port=0)
            with open(self.token_path, "w") as token:
                token.write(creds.to_json())
        self.service = build("drive", "v3", credentials=creds)

    def upload(self, local_path: str, remote_name: str) -> str:
        """Upload file to Google Drive."""
        if not self.service:
            raise RuntimeError("Not authorized. Run `python -m backup_tool` first.")
        file_metadata = {
            "name": remote_name,
            "parents": [self.config.get("google_folder_id", "")]
        }
        media = None
        try:
            media = self._create_media_file(local_path)
            file = self.service.files().create(
                body=file_metadata,
                media_body=media,
                fields="id"
            ).execute()
            return file.get("id")
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Upload failed: {e}")

    def _create_media_file(self, local_path: str) -> Any:
        """Create media file for upload."""
        from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload
        return MediaFileUpload(local_path, resumable=True)
```

## 🚀 How to Use

### 1. Initialize

Create `config.json`:

```json
{
  "local_backup_path": "backup",
  "cloud_enabled": true,
  "cloud_type": "google_drive",
  "google_credentials_path": "credentials.json",
  "google_folder_id": "1abc2def...",
  "schedule": {
    "notes": "0 3 * * *",
    "tasks": "0 4 * * *"
  },
  "auto_backup": true,
  "max_versions": 5
}
```

### 2. Set up Google Drive

- Create a Google Cloud project and enable Drive API.
- Download `credentials.json` from Google Cloud Console.
- Run `python -m backup_tool` — it will open a browser to authorize.

### 3. Add data

Run `python -m backup_tool` and choose option `[2] Add entry`.

### 4. Backup

Choose `[5] Backup now` or wait for scheduled backups.

### 5. Restore

Choose `[7] Restore version` and pick from the list.

### 6. Compare

Choose `[8] Compare versions`.

- **Security**: Credentials are stored locally. For production, use secrets managers.
- **Cloud**: Only Google Drive is implemented. Add others via plugins.
- **Versioning**: Uses SQLite snapshots. For larger datasets, consider snapshotting with `pg_dump` or `mysqldump`.

// ===== SETUP =====
import * as THREE from 'three';

const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');

// ===== LIGHTING =====

const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;

// ===== PARTICLES =====
const starGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
const starCount = 3000;
const starPos = new Float32Array(starCount * 3);
for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
    const r = 120 + Math.random() * 400;

shipBody.position.set(0, 0.8, 0);
shipBody.castShadow = true;
shipBody.receiveShadow = true;
shipBody.userData = { type: 'ship' };

const shipCore = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3, 12, 12),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffaa00, emissive: 0x444400, emissiveIntensity: 0.4, metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.2 })
);
shipCore.position.set(0, 0, 0);
shipGroup.add(shipCore);

const shieldMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x44aaee, transparent: true, opacity: 0.35 });
const shield = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.6, 32, 32), shieldMat);
shield.position.set(0, 0, 0);
shield.visible = false;
shipGroup.add(shield);

// ===== WEAPON =====
const weaponGroup = new THREE.Group();
scene.add(weaponGroup);

const weaponCore = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.08, 0.4, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 })
);
weaponCore.position.set(0, 0, 0);
weaponGroup.add(weaponCore);

const weaponTip = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.05, 0.15, 6),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 })
);
weaponTip.position.set(0, 0, 0.4);
weaponGroup.add(weaponTip);

// ===== ASTEROID FACTORY =====
const asteroidPool = [];
const asteroidMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x886644, metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.4 });
const asteroidMatGlow = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffaa88, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6 });

function createAsteroid(radius, color, parent) {
    const geo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(radius, 0);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, asteroidMat);
    mesh.position.set(0, 0, 0);
    mesh.castShadow = true;
    mesh.receiveShadow = true;
    mesh.userData = { type: 'asteroid', radius, color, hp: 1 };
    mesh.userData.originalMat = mesh.material;
    mesh.userData.glow = new THREE.Mesh(geo, asteroidMatGlow);
    mesh.userData.glow.visible = false;
    mesh.add(mesh.userData.glow);
    parent.add(mesh);
    return mesh;
}

function spawnAsteroid() {
    const radius = 20 + Math.random() * 60;
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const dist = radius + Math.random() * 40;
    const x = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
    const z = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(group);
    asteroidPool.push(group);
    const count = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = createAsteroid(0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2, 0x886644, group);
        a.position.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
        a.position.y = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
        a.position.z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
        a.rotation.set(Math.random() * Math.PI, Math.random() * Math.PI, Math.random() * Math.PI);
        a.userData.vel = new THREE.Vector3(
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
            0.05 + Math.random() * 0.15,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2
        );
        a.userData.size = a.geometry.parameters.radius;
    }
    group.userData.spawnTime = performance.now();
}

// ===== BULLET FACTORY =====
const bulletPool = [];
function createBullet() {
    const geo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.05, 0.6, 6);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff });
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.userData = { type: 'bullet' };
    return mesh;
}
function spawnBullet(dir) {
    const b = bulletPool.length ? bulletPool.pop() : createBullet();
    b.position.set(0, 0, 0);
    b.rotation.z = Math.atan2(dir.z, dir.x);
    b.userData.vel = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(15);
    shipGroup.add(b);
}

// ===== SHIELD IMPACT =====
const impactPool = [];
function createImpact() {
    const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.4, 16, 16);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.userData = { type: 'impact', life: 1.2, size: 0.4 };
    return mesh;
}
function spawnImpact(pos, size = 0.4) {
    const i = impactPool.length ? impactPool.pop() : createImpact();
    i.position.copy(pos);
    i.scale.setScalar(size);
    i.userData.size = size;
    shipGroup.add(i);
    setTimeout(() => { shipGroup.remove(i); i.userData.life = 1.2; impactPool.push(i); }, 600);
}

// ===== SCORE & UI =====
const scoreEl = document.createElement('div');
scoreEl.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:10px;left:10px;font-family:monospace;font-size:18px;color:#fff;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000;z-index:10;';
document.body.appendChild(scoreEl);
const shieldEl = document.createElement('div');
shieldEl.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:10px;right:10px;font-family:monospace;font-size:18px;color:#fff;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000;z-index:10;';
document.body.appendChild(shieldEl);
const hpEl = document.createElement('div');
hpEl.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:40px;left:10px;font-family:monospace;font-size:14px;color:#fff;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000;z-index:10;';
document.body.appendChild(hpEl);

let score = 0, shield = 100, hp = 3;
let spawnTimer = 0, lastSpawn = 0;
let particles = [];

function updateUI() {
    scoreEl.textContent = `SCORE: ${score}`;
    shieldEl.textContent = `SHIELD: ${shield.toFixed(0)}`;
    hpEl.textContent = `HP: ${hp}`;
}

// ===== INPUT =====
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.code === 'Space') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
        camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
        spawnBullet(dir);
    }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// Mouse aim
let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    mouseX = (e.clientX / canvas.clientWidth) * 2 - 1;
    mouseY = -(e.clientY / canvas.clientHeight) * 2 + 1;
});
let yaw = 0, pitch = 0;
function updateAim() {
    yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(mouseX * 0.25, -0.7, 0.7);
    pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(mouseY * 0.25, -0.7, 0.7);
}

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update(dt) {
    const t = dt * 0.001; // seconds

    // Player movement
    const forward = new THREE.Vector3();
    const right = new THREE.Vector3();
    camera.getWorldDirection(forward);
    forward.y = 0; forward.normalize();
    right.set(0, 0, 1).crossVectors(forward).normalize();
    const move = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (keys['KeyW']) move.add(forward);
    if (keys['KeyS']) move.sub(forward);
    if (keys['KeyD']) move.add(right);
    if (keys['KeyA']) move.sub(right);
    move.normalize();
    shipGroup.position.add(move.multiplyScalar(6 * t));

    // Rotation
    shipGroup.rotation.y = yaw;
    shipGroup.rotation.x = pitch;

    // Weapon rotation
    weaponGroup.rotation.y = yaw;
    weaponGroup.rotation.x = pitch;

    // Shield flicker
    shieldMat.opacity = 0.35 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.005) * 0.15;

    // Asteroids
    for (let i = asteroidPool.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const group = asteroidPool[i];
        const asteroids = group.children;
        for (let j = asteroids.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            const a = asteroids[j];
            a.position.add(a.userData.vel.clone().multiplyScalar(t));
            a.rotation.y += 0.01 * t;
            a.rotation.x += 0.005 * t;

            // Glow on edge
            a.userData.glow.visible = a.userData.hp < 1;

            // Collision with bullets
            for (let k = shipGroup.children.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
                const b = shipGroup.children[k];
                if (b.userData.type !== 'bullet') continue;
                const dx = a.position.x - b.position.x;
                const dy = a.position.y - b.position.y;
                const dz = a.position.z - b.position.z;
                const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
                if (d < a.userData.size + 0.1) {
                    a.userData.hp -= 1;
                    b.geometry.dispose();
                    b.material.dispose();
                    b.userData.type = 'dead';
                    shipGroup.remove(b);
                    bulletPool.push(b);
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (a.userData.hp <= 0) {
                // Fragment
                fragmentAsteroid(a, group);
                group.remove(a);
                a.geometry.dispose();
                a.material.dispose();
                a.userData.originalMat.dispose();
                a.userData.glow.geometry.dispose();
                a.userData.glow.material.dispose();
                a.userData.glow.dispose();
                a.userData.originalMat.dispose();
                a.userData.glow.dispose();
                a.userData.glow = null;
                a.userData.originalMat = null;
                a.geometry.dispose();
                a.material.dispose();
                a.dispose();
                continue;
            }
        }
        // Remove empty groups
        if (asteroids.length === 0) {
            scene.remove(group);
            asteroidPool.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }

    // Bullets
    for (let i = shipGroup.children.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const b = shipGroup.children[i];
        if (b.userData.type !== 'bullet') continue;
        b.position.add(b.userData.vel.clone().multiplyScalar(t));
        b.rotation.y += 0.05 * t;
        if (b.position.y < -5 || b.position.y > 5 || b.position.x > 15 || b.position.x < -15 || b.position.z > 15 || b.position.z < -15) {
            b.geometry.dispose();
            b.material.dispose();
            b.userData.type = 'dead';
            shipGroup.remove(b);
            bulletPool.push(b);
        }
    }

    // Shield hit
    if (hp > 0) {
        const shieldBox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(shipGroup);
        for (let i = asteroidPool.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const group = asteroidPool[i];
            const asteroids = group.children;
            for (let j = asteroids.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                const a = asteroids[j];
                const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(a);
                if (shieldBox.intersectsBox(box)) {
                    shield -= 5;
                    if (shield <= 0) {
                        shield = 0;
                        spawnImpact(shipGroup.position, 1.2);
                        hp -= 1;
                        updateUI();
                        if (hp <= 0) {
                            gameOver();
                        }
                    }
                    a.userData.hp -= 0.5;
                    if (a.userData.hp <= 0) {
                        fragmentAsteroid(a, group);
                        group.remove(a);
                        a.geometry.dispose();
                        a.material.dispose();
                        a.userData.originalMat.dispose();
                        a.userData.glow.geometry.dispose();
                        a.userData.glow.material.dispose();
                        a.userData.glow.dispose();
                        a.userData.originalMat.dispose();
                        a.userData.glow.dispose();
                        a.userData.glow = null;
                        a.userData.originalMat = null;
                        a.geometry.dispose();
                        a.material.dispose();
                        a.dispose();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const p = particles[i];
        p.position.y += p.vel.y * t;
        p.position.x += p.vel.x * t;
        p.position.z += p.vel.z * t;
        p.scale.setScalar(p.scale.x - t * 0.08);
        p.material.opacity -= t * 0.05;
        if (p.scale.x < 0.05 || p.material.opacity < 0.05) {
            p.geometry.dispose();
            p.material.dispose();
            p.userData.dead = true;
            particles.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }

    // Spawn
    spawnTimer += dt;
    if (spawnTimer > 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5) {
        spawnAsteroid();
        spawnTimer = 0;
    }

    // Dynamic lighting: sun rotates slowly
    sun.position.x = 100 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.0005) * 50;
    sun.position.z = 50 + Math.cos(performance.now() * 0.0005) * 50;

    // Camera follow
    const shipPos = shipGroup.position;
    const camTarget = shipPos.clone();
    camTarget.y += 3;
    camTarget.z -= 4;
    camera.lookAt(camTarget);

    // Third-person camera offset
    camera.position.x = shipPos.x + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.001) * 0.5;
    camera.position.y = shipPos.y + 10;
    camera.position.z = shipPos.z + Math.cos(performance.now() * 0.001) * 0.5;

    // Controls
    controls.update();

    updateUI();
}

function fragmentAsteroid(a, group) {
    const size = a.userData.size;
    const count = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const frag = createAsteroid(size * 0.6, 0x664422, group);
        frag.position.copy(a.position);
        frag.userData.vel = new THREE.Vector3(
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4
        );
        frag.userData.size = size * 0.6;
        group.add(frag);
        frag.userData.hp = 1;
        frag.userData.originalMat = frag.material;
        frag.userData.glow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(frag.userData.size, 0), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffaa88, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5 }));
        frag.userData.glow.visible = false;
        frag.add(frag.userData.glow);
    }
}

function spawnParticles(pos, color, count = 20) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 8, 8);
        const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 });
        const p = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
        p.position.set(
            pos.x + Math.cos(angle) * 0.5,
            pos.y + Math.random() * 1.5,
            pos.z + Math.sin(angle) * 0.5
        );
        p.vel = new THREE.Vector3(
            Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
            Math.sin(angle) * speed
        );
        p.scale.setScalar(0.1);
        scene.add(p);
        p.userData.dead = false;
        particles.push(p);
    }
}

function gameOver() {
    alert(`GAME OVER\nFinal Score: ${score}`);
    score = 0;
    shield = 100;
    hp = 3;
    updateUI();
    for (let i = shipGroup.children.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const c = shipGroup.children[i];
        if (c.userData.type === 'bullet') {
            c.geometry.dispose();
            c.material.dispose();
            shipGroup.remove(c);
            bulletPool.push(c);
        }
    }
    for (let i = asteroidPool.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const g = asteroidPool[i];
        scene.remove(g);
        for (let j = g.children.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            const a = g.children[j];
            a.geometry.dispose();
            a.material.dispose();
            a.userData.originalMat.dispose();
            a.userData.glow.geometry.dispose();
            a.userData.glow.material.dispose();
            a.userData.glow.dispose();
            a.userData.originalMat.dispose();
            a.userData.glow.dispose();
            a.userData.glow = null;
            a.userData.originalMat = null;
            a.geometry.dispose();
            a.material.dispose();
            a.dispose();
        }
        asteroidPool.splice(i, 1);
    }
    shipGroup.position.set(0, 0, 0);
    shipGroup.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
    shipGroup.children.forEach(c => {
        if (c.userData.type === 'bullet') {
            c.geometry.dispose();
            c.material.dispose();
            shipGroup.remove(c);
            bulletPool.push(c);
        }
    });
    shipGroup.add(shipBody);
    shipGroup.add(shipCore);
    shieldMat.opacity = 0.35;
    shieldMat.visible = false;
    shield = 100;
    updateUI();
}

// ===== ANIMATION LOOP =====
function loop() {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, performance.now() - lastSpawn);
    lastSpawn = performance.now();
    update(dt);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

// ===== RESIZE =====
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});

// ===== START =====
spawnAsteroid();
spawnAsteroid();
spawnAsteroid();
updateUI();

Below is a **Laboratory Instrument Management System** implemented in **Python** using **Flask** (backend) and **HTML/CSS/JavaScript** (frontend). The system features: - **User roles**: `User` (search, view details, check status) and `Admin` (add, update, manage maintenance). - **Instruments** with parameters (name, type, serial, location, status, parameters). - **Maintenance records** tracked per instrument. - **Persistent storage** via SQLite. - **Authentication** with role-based access. --- ## 📁 Project Structure ``` lab_instrument_system/ ├── app.py ├── models.py ├── static/ │ ├── css/ │ │ └── style.css │ └── js/ │ └── main.js ├── templates/ │ ├── base.html │ ├── login.html │ ├── dashboard.html │ ├── instruments.html │ ├── instrument_detail.html │ ├── admin.html │ └── maintenance.html ├── requirements.txt └── README.md ``` --- ## 📄 `requirements.txt` ```txt Flask==3.0.3 Flask-SQLAlchemy==3.0.5 Flask-WTF==1.1.4 WTForms==3.0.1 werkzeug==2.3.7 ``` --- ## 📄 `models.py` ```python from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy from datetime import datetime db = SQLAlchemy() class User(db.Model): __tablename__ = 'users' id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True) username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False) password = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False) role = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=False, default='user') # 'user' or 'admin' class Instrument(db.Model): __tablename__ = 'instruments' id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True) name = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False) type = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False) serial = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False) location = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False) status = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=False, default='available') # available, occupied, under_maintenance parameters = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True) # JSON-like string created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) def __init__(self, name, type, serial, location, parameters=None, status='available'): self.name = name self.type = type self.serial = serial self.location = location self.parameters = parameters self.status = status def to_dict(self): return { 'id': self.id, 'name': self.name, 'type': self.type, 'serial': self.serial, 'location': self.location, 'status': self.status, 'parameters': self.parameters, 'created_at': self.created_at.isoformat() if self.created_at else None } class Maintenance(db.Model): __tablename__ = 'maintenance' id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True) instrument_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('instruments.id'), nullable=False) description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False) performed_by = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False) date = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) status = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=False, default='completed') # completed, pending, in_progress def __init__(self, instrument_id, description, performed_by, status='completed'): self.instrument_id = instrument_id self.description = description self.performed_by = performed_by self.status = status def to_dict(self): return { 'id': self.id, 'instrument_id': self.instrument_id, 'description': self.description, 'performed_by': self.performed_by, 'date': self.date.isoformat(), 'status': self.status } ``` --- ## 📄 `app.py` ```python from flask import Flask, render_template, request, redirect, url_for, flash, jsonify, session from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy from flask_wtf import FlaskForm from wtforms import StringField, PasswordField, SubmitField, TextAreaField, SelectField from wtforms.validators import DataRequired, Length, Email from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash, check_password_hash import json app = Flask(__name__) app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = 'your-secret-key-here' app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///lab_instruments.db' app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False db = SQLAlchemy(app) # Initialize database def init_db(): with app.app_context(): db.create_all() if User.query.count() == 0: admin = User(username='admin', password=generate_password_hash('admin123'), role='admin') user = User(username='user', password=generate_password_hash('user123'), role='user') db.session.add(admin) db.session.add(user) db.session.commit() # ---------- Forms ---------- class LoginForm(FlaskForm): username = StringField('Username', validators=[DataRequired()]) password = PasswordField('Password', validators=[DataRequired()]) submit = SubmitField('Login') class InstrumentForm(FlaskForm): name = StringField('Instrument Name', validators=[DataRequired()]) type = StringField('Type', validators=[DataRequired()]) serial = StringField('Serial Number', validators=[DataRequired(), Length(min=5)]) location = StringField('Location', validators=[DataRequired()]) parameters = TextAreaField('Parameters (JSON-like, optional)', render_kw={'rows': 4}) status = SelectField('Status', choices=[('available', 'Available'), ('occupied', 'Occupied'), ('under_maintenance', 'Under Maintenance')]) class MaintenanceForm(FlaskForm): description = TextAreaField('Description', validators=[DataRequired()]) performed_by = StringField('Performed By', validators=[DataRequired()]) status = SelectField('Status', choices=[('completed', 'Completed'), ('pending', 'Pending'), ('in_progress', 'In Progress')]) # ---------- Auth ---------- @app.route('/', methods=['GET', 'POST']) def login(): if request.method == 'POST': form = LoginForm(request.form) if form.validate(): user = User.query.filter_by(username=form.username.data).first() if user and check_password_hash(user.password, form.password.data): session['user_id'] = user.id session['username'] = user.username session['role'] = user.role flash(f'Welcome, {user.username}!', 'success') return redirect(url_for('dashboard')) else: flash('Invalid username or password', 'error') return render_template('login.html', form=LoginForm()) @app.route('/logout') def logout(): session.clear() flash('You have been logged out.', 'info') return redirect(url_for('login')) def require_role(role): def decorator(f): def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs): if 'user_id' not in session: flash('Please log in.', 'error') return redirect(url_for('login')) user = User.query.get(session['user_id']) if user.role != role: flash(f'Access denied. Admins only.', 'error') return redirect(url_for('dashboard')) return f(*args, **kwargs) return decorated_function return decorator # ---------- Dashboard ---------- @app.route('/dashboard') def dashboard(): if 'user_id' not in session: return redirect(url_for('login')) user = User.query.get(session['user_id']) instruments = Instrument.query.all() return render_template('dashboard.html', user=user, instruments=instruments) # ---------- Instruments ---------- @app.route('/instruments') def instruments(): if 'user_id' not in session: return redirect(url_for('login')) query = request.args.get('q', '').strip().lower() status_filter = request.args.get('status', '').strip() instruments = Instrument.query.all() if query: instruments = [i for i in instruments if query in i.name.lower() or query in i.type.lower() or query in i.serial.lower()] if status_filter: instruments = [i for i in instruments if i.status == status_filter] return render_template('instruments.html', instruments=instruments, query=query, status_filter=status_filter) @app.route('/instrument/') def instrument_detail(id): if 'user_id' not in session: return redirect(url_for('login')) instrument = Instrument.query.get_or_404(id) maintenances = Maintenance.query.filter_by(instrument_id=id).all() return render_template('instrument_detail.html', instrument=instrument, maintenances=maintenances) # ---------- Admin ---------- @app.route('/admin') @require_role('admin') def admin(): instruments = Instrument.query.all() return render_template('admin.html', instruments=instruments) @app.route('/admin/add', methods=['GET', 'POST']) @require_role('admin') def admin_add(): form = InstrumentForm() if form.validate_on_submit(): parameters = form.parameters.data.strip() if parameters and not parameters.startswith('{') and not parameters.startswith('['): parameters = json.dumps({k.strip(): v.strip() for k, v in [p.split(':', 1) for p in parameters.splitlines()] if ':' in p}) instrument = Instrument( name=form.name.data, type=form.type.data, serial=form.serial.data, location=form.location.data, parameters=parameters, status=form.status.data ) db.session.add(instrument) db.session.commit() flash(f'Instrument "{form.name.data}" added successfully.', 'success') return redirect(url_for('admin')) return render_template('admin.html', form=form, title='Add Instrument') @app.route('/admin/edit/', methods=['GET', 'POST']) @require_role('admin') def admin_edit(id): instrument = Instrument.query.get_or_404(id) form = InstrumentForm(obj=instrument) if form.validate_on_submit(): parameters = form.parameters.data.strip() if parameters and not parameters.startswith('{') and not parameters.startswith('['): parameters = json.dumps({k.strip(): v.strip() for k, v in [p.split(':', 1) for p in parameters.splitlines()] if ':' in p}) instrument.name = form.name.data instrument.type = form.type.data instrument.serial = form.serial.data instrument.location = form.location.data instrument.parameters = parameters instrument.status = form.status.data db.session.commit() flash(f'Instrument "{form.name.data}" updated.', 'success') return redirect(url_for('admin')) return render_template('admin.html', form=form, title='Edit Instrument', instrument=instrument) @app.route('/admin/delete/', methods=['POST']) @require_role('admin') def admin_delete(id): instrument = Instrument.query.get_or_404(id) db.session.delete(instrument) db.session.commit() flash(f'Instrument "{instrument.name}" deleted.', 'info') return redirect(url_for('admin')) # ---------- Maintenance ---------- @app.route('/maintenance/', methods=['GET', 'POST']) @require_role('admin') def maintenance(id): instrument = Instrument.query.get_or_404(id) maintenances = Maintenance.query.filter_by(instrument_id=id).all() form = MaintenanceForm() if form.validate_on_submit(): maintenance = Maintenance( instrument_id=id, description=form.description.data, performed_by=form.performed_by.data, status=form.status.data ) db.session.add(maintenance) db.session.commit() flash(f'Maintenance record added for "{instrument.name}".', 'success') return redirect(url_for('maintenance', id=id)) return render_template('maintenance.html', instrument=instrument, maintenances=maintenances, form=form) @app.route('/maintenance//update/', methods=['GET', 'POST']) @require_role('admin') def maintenance_update(id, m_id): maintenance = Maintenance.query.get_or_404(m_id) form = MaintenanceForm(obj=maintenance) if form.validate_on_submit(): maintenance.description = form.description.data maintenance.performed_by = form.performed_by.data maintenance.status = form.status.data db.session.commit() flash('Maintenance record updated.', 'success') return redirect(url_for('maintenance', id=id)) return render_template('maintenance.html', instrument=Instrument.query.get(id), maintenances=[maintenance], form=form) @app.route('/maintenance//delete/', methods=['POST']) @require_role('admin') def maintenance_delete(id, m_id): maintenance = Maintenance.query.get_or_404(m_id) db.session.delete(maintenance) db.session.commit() flash('Maintenance record deleted.', 'info') return redirect(url_for('maintenance', id=id)) # ---------- API endpoints for frontend (optional) if query: instruments = [i for i in instruments if query in i.name.lower() or query in i.type.lower() or query in i.serial.lower()] if status: instruments = [i for i in instruments if i.status == status] return jsonify([i.to_dict() for i in instruments]) @app.route('/api/maintenance/') def api_maintenance(id): maintenances = Maintenance.query.filter_by(instrument_id=id).all() return
